toegepas.voor: Daardie manier van dink en doen se naam is stigma
toegepas.na: So 'n manier van dink en doen noem ons stigma
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'se naam is' is wooden; 'noem ons' is the natural way to introduce a term, same word count.
toegepas.fout: 'se naam is' is a wooden way to introduce a term.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'noem ons stigma' is the natural Afrikaans way to name a concept and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Dit kom uit in wat hulle doen en sê
toegepas.na: Dit blyk uit wat hulle doen en sê
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'kom uit in' calques English 'comes out in'; 'blyk uit' is the idiomatic Afrikaans and one word shorter.
toegepas.fout: 'kom uit in' copies English 'comes out in'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'blyk uit' is the idiomatic Afrikaans and keeps the sense that the thinking shows in actions and words.

toegepas.voor: Hulle wil nie 'n beker deel nie
toegepas.na: Hulle wil nie 'n beker met hom deel nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'deel' needs its partner here; without 'met hom' the sentence does not say whom they refuse to share with.
toegepas.fout: 'nie 'n beker deel nie' can read as refusing to share cups in general rather than with the friend.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'met hom' makes the exclusion point at the friend, which the paragraph already intends, and adds no new fact.

toegepas.voor: Al hierdie dinge maak seer en die skade
toegepas.na: Al hierdie dinge maak seer, en die skade
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subjects and verbs.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dinge maak seer' and 'die skade gaan verder' are two full clauses, so the comma before 'en' is required.

toegepas.voor: en die vrees is nie waar nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: A fear is not 'true' or 'untrue'; 'klop nie' is the idiomatic expression and matches the block heading.
toegepas.fout: A fear cannot be 'true' or 'untrue'; the wording is imprecise.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'die vrees klop nie' says exactly that the fear is unfounded and matches the block heading.

toegepas.voor: Niks van daardie gewone dinge bring MIV na jou toe nie
toegepas.na: Nie een van daardie gewone dinge gee jou MIV nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'bring MIV na jou toe' is unnatural and 'niks van' sits awkwardly with countable things; same word count.
toegepas.fout: 'bring MIV na jou toe' is unnatural and 'niks van' sits awkwardly with countable things.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Nie een van daardie gewone dinge gee jou MIV nie' is plain natural Afrikaans with the same meaning and is shorter.

toegepas.blok: Jy kry nie MIV van hierdie dinge nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: In an infinitive-style phrase the verb goes last, as in the parallel item 'Saam speel en langs mekaar in die klas sit'.
toegepas.fout: 'Saam eet uit een pot' follows English word order.
toegepas.rede_keurder: In this verb phrase Afrikaans puts the verb last, as the neighbouring list items do.

toegepas.blok: Mense wat met MIV leef, leef gewone lewens
toegepas.voor: drink elke dag medisyne en dit hou
toegepas.na: drink elke dag medisyne, en dit hou
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: 'dit hou hulle gesond' has its own subject and verb, so a comma goes before 'en'; the protected wording is untouched.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subjects and verbs.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dit hou hulle gesond' has its own subject and verb, and the protected wording 'Die meeste mense wat met MIV leef' is untouched.

toegepas.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'verander by' is the wrong preposition; an attitude changes through ('deur') small daily actions.
toegepas.fout: 'verander by' is an awkward preposition for how an attitude changes.
toegepas.rede_keurder: In both versions the attitude changes as you do small daily things, so 'deur' fixes the preposition without moving who does what.

toegepas.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
toegepas.na: Behandel hom in die eerste plek as
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'eerste' as an adverb here copies English 'first'; Afrikaans says 'in die eerste plek' (reviewer may prefer simply dropping 'eerste' to save words).
toegepas.fout: 'eerste' as an adverb here copies English 'first'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'in die eerste plek' is the natural Afrikaans for priority and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.blok: As stigma jou of jou gesin tref
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'lelik is' can be read as 'are ugly'; 'lelik optree' clearly means behave nastily, same word count.
toegepas.fout: 'mense lelik is' can be read as 'people are ugly'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'lelik optree' clearly means behaving nastily, which is what the sentence intends, with the same word count.

toegepas.voor: Die woorde wat ons kies dra
toegepas.na: Die woorde wat ons kies, dra
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the relative clause before the main verb, as the lesson does elsewhere ('Iemand wat bang is vir ander se woorde, hou').
toegepas.fout: Missing comma where the relative clause ends and the main verb follows.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma between 'kies' and 'dra' eases reading and matches the lesson's own use elsewhere.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma before 'omdat' separates the two uses of 'leef' and makes the point of the sentence easier to see; the protected wording is untouched.
toegepas.fout: Without a comma 'omdat' can attach to the relative clause and the point of the sentence is hard to see.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma ties 'omdat hulle leef' to 'Ons praat van' as intended, and the protected wording is untouched.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
laat_vaar.voor: nooi hom saam om te speel
laat_vaar.na: nooi hom om saam te speel
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'nooi hom om saam te speel' is the natural order; same words.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'nooi hom saam' is the correct separable verb saamnooi, already used earlier in the lesson, so the reorder is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
laat_vaar.voor: Sê iets wanneer iemand geterg word, of gaan haal 'n grootmens
laat_vaar.na: Sê iets of gaan haal 'n grootmens wanneer iemand geterg word
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Putting both commands together removes the comma before a subjectless command half and the misreading 'iemand ... gaan haal 'n grootmens'; same words, same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original safety instruction reads clearly and the reorder only reads differently.

laat_vaar.blok: As stigma jou of jou gesin tref
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'bly' plus a verb for 'keep on' is colloquial and reads like a contradiction beside 'gaan'; 'steeds' is clearer, same word count.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'bly' plus a verb for 'keep on' is standard Afrikaans, so 'steeds' is a lateral swap in a health instruction.

laat_vaar.voor: wat hy het of is, en hom daarom
laat_vaar.na: wat hy het of is en hom daarom
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: AWS: the 'en' half has no subject of its own (it shares 'mense'), so no comma before 'en'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: In this glossary definition the comma closes the relative clause 'wat hy het of is' and prevents a misreading, so removing it is not clearly better.

na_skrywer.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'aandra' also means telling tales to an adult ('klik'), which sits badly beside the instructions to tell an adult; 'versprei' says only spreading gossip.
na_skrywer.fout: 'aandra' can also mean telling tales to an adult, which sits badly beside the instructions to tell a trusted adult.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real in an instruction about whom to tell, but 'versprei' overlaps with 'oorvertel' and shifts the pair's meaning, so the writer should fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The nearest antecedent of 'hy' is 'n grootmens', so the safety instruction can be read as the adult getting hurt; naming the friend removes that.
na_skrywer.fout: The nearest antecedent of 'hy' is 'n grootmens', so the instruction can be read as the adult getting hurt.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The pronoun fault is real, but it sits in a safety instruction about when to tell an adult, which the writer owns.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Mense wat met MIV leef, leef gewone lewens
vlae.teks: Jy sal nie aan iemand kan sien dat sy met MIV leef nie.
vlae.rede: Everywhere else the lesson refers to 'iemand' as 'hy'; 'sy' here may be a deliberate gender balance, so not changed, but a person may want to confirm it is intended.
